name: running-the-app
title: Running the app
description: CLI for running the app
instructions:
Run this command from the project root, which contains package.json:

npm run dev

Open the URL printed by Vite and choose World Search. The host and port come from this project's current configuration. Stop the server with Ctrl+C.

name: runner-new-react-project-kit

description: Searches with per-field BM25, frozen semantic and supervised RRF channels plus a relative reranker.

name: train-hybrid-seat-ranking
title: Build Retrieval Checkpoint
description: Build a retrieval checkpoint from approved field feedback. The default mode activates it; candidate mode leaves the active checkpoint unchanged. Pending suggestions remain unapproved.

name: use-train-hybrid-seat-ranking
title: Indexes supervised third-channel query/field evidence and saves checkpoints for frozen BM25/semantic/RRF models and reranking.
description: Indexes supervised third-channel query/field evidence and saves checkpoints for frozen BM25/semantic/RRF models and reranking.

name: train-field-feedback
title: Save Field Feedback

description: Records an explicit user field judgment or rephrase and trains supervised field/query evidence.

name: refresh-world-database
title: Refresh Search Catalog
description: Update the search database from registered source locations. Keep row IDs, remove stale rows, and do not train a model.

name: use-refresh-world-database
title: Refresh world database
description: Refresh or reindex search after adding or changing components, tools, records, or skills. Update the SQLite database from folders in root rab.project.json. This does not train the model.

name: runner-use-tool
title: Search, load, and run a RAB World tool
description: Searches registered tools and runners by query, loads a selected tool's current registration and adjacent skill instructions by House ID, or executes a selected registered tool or runner. Uses runner-tooling-and-tracking through runTools for flat ordered execution records.

name: tune-ranking-model
title: Tune Ranking Model
description: Train cross-encoder weights from reviewed answer grades. The tool saves a candidate. Activation is a separate step after evaluation.

name: use-tune-ranking-model
title: Fine-tune ranking model
description: Fine-tune the local cross-encoder ranking model from reviewed graded answers. Retain versioned training chunks, exact dataset snapshots, changed model weights, held-out evaluation, progress, disk sizes and candidate checkpoints. Read status without inference; activate only candidates passing evaluation.

name: compare-ranking-checkpoints
title: Compare Ranking Checkpoints
description: Compare active and candidate search results for one saved tuning run. The report uses the same catalog and judged answers. It does not activate a candidate.

name: inspect-ranking-attention
title: Inspect Ranking Attention
description: Inspect one attention layer and head for a question and document. Choose active or candidate weights. The report shows tokens and any input truncation.

name: use-compare-ranking-checkpoints
title: compare-ranking-checkpoints
description: Compare active and candidate search rankings on the same saved catalog and held-out whole-answer judgments. Reports gains and regressions without activation.

name: use-inspect-ranking-attention
title: inspect-ranking-attention
description: Inspect one cross-encoder attention layer/head for a question and answer using active or candidate weights. Returns token labels and measured attention, with explicit truncation.

name: use-runner-use-tool
description: Search for, inspect, and invoke a registered RAB World tool or runner.
